instruction: Help me to install Nordic theme from gnome-look.org and make it the active theme for my GNOME desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing Nordic theme from gnome-look.org and applying it to GNOME desktop. Evaluator checks if gtk-theme setting contains 'Nordic' using gsettings command. Similar to original task but with different theme name.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses gsettings to check GTK theme setting, which is appropriate for GNOME theme verification
The check_list metric with regex pattern 'Nordic' correctly matches the expected theme name in gsettings output
Expected value 'Nordic' is semantically correct for verifying the Nordic theme is active
Postconfig command execution is correct and will capture the theme setting to cache file

Minor coverage issue: Only GTK theme (org.gnome.desktop.interface gtk-theme) is checked, but GNOME Shell theme (org.gnome.shell.extensions.user-theme name) is not verified. For complete GNOME desktop theming, both components should ideally be checked
However, GTK theme is the primary and most commonly referenced 'desktop theme', so this partial verification is acceptable for most use cases
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding a second postconfig command to check GNOME Shell theme: gsettings get org.gnome.shell.extensions.user-theme name
Alternative: Update instruction to be more specific about whether it means GTK theme only or full GNOME desktop theme (GTK + Shell)
